messages:
Kyra Moss: Hey all — Kyra joining eng-platform today! Quick list of first-day blockers: MDM shows 'stuck', can't access corp VPN, Docker permissions are denied on dev hosts, and I'm trying to reserve a small GPU for a demo (just 1x A10). Also: fun fact — I collect vintage camera lenses.
Lena (People Ops): Welcome, Kyra!! :tada: Your buddy is Nina — she'll loop you into team rhythms. DM me your laptop serial and tshirt size and I'll kick off the kit. If MDM is stuck, reply here with 'mdm-resend' and MDM Bot will resend the invite.
Nina (Buddy): hey Kyra :wave: hi from eng-platform. For Docker perms, we usually add new folks to the `docker` group on the dev hosts. Marcus owns that flow — Marcus, can you add kyra.moss@redwood.com? I'll also book a quick 20m intro with the team.
Marcus (Infra): adding now. Kyra, can you paste your corp email and github handle? I'll also file a GPU short-term reservation (sandbox) — ETA on approval ~30m.
Kyra Moss: corp email: kyra.moss@redwood.com, github: kyra-moss. Laptop serial: ZT9P3L40022. Tshirt: M. Thanks!
MDM Bot: Device ZT9P3L40022: enrollment pending. To resend the invite reply with exactly: `mdm-resend`.
Kyra Moss: mdm-resend
MDM Bot: Enrollment invite resent to kyra.moss@redwood.com. If you don't receive the email in 5 minutes, reboot and run `profiles status -type enrollment` then reply here.
Kyra Moss: got it, enrolling now. Also, Docker still shows: `permission denied: user not part of docker group` when trying `docker ps`.
Marcus (Infra): added kyra.moss@redwood.com to `docker` on dev hosts and to `eng-platform` LDAP group. Try `ssh dev-host-02` then `newgrp docker` or log out and log back in. GPU reservation created: ticket #9922 (sandbox-a10-1) — you'll get access once the quota clears.
DevEx Bot: Note: starter repo for eng-platform demos is `git@github.com:redwood/platform-starters`. There's a `gpu-demo/README.md` with quick steps.
Kyra Moss: enrollment completed, VPN connected! Docker group change worked after relog. nvidia-smi on sandbox node shows A10 present once Marcus confirmed access. Thanks everyone.
Nina (Buddy): woohoo :confetti_ball: calendar invite for a 20m intro sent for 4pm PT. We'll show you the repo, CI flow, and where we keep runbooks. Also — camera lens club meets Friday, bring a pic if you want :camera_flash:
Lena (People Ops): Added you to the new-hire checklist and scheduled the all-hands intro slot. Welcome to Redwood! :heart:
